_doc: DRAFTED presentation overlay — machine first draft from the build's own terminals, NOT an operator ruling. tier: default 67, 147 only where the terminal's own grounded text shows money at stake, a live deadline, or an adverse determination. Escapes are forced to tier 67 by the translator. Rule the tiers, then re-run emit-engine with --accept-overlay. Remove _drafted once ruled.
_doctrine: structural/critical → 147; explainer/guidance → 67. Every row's evidence is printed by the drafter.

none_fit: ⚠SPECIALISE:generic copy, make it about this product
insufficient_information: ⚠SPECIALISE:generic copy, make it about this product

none_fit.heading: This check may not cover your situation
none_fit.result_copy: Your answers do not match any of the situations this check is built to resolve. That does not mean nothing applies to you — it means this particular check is not the right instrument for the question you are asking, and forcing an answer here would give you a false read. If the subject is still relevant to you, a short personalised review establishes which rules actually govern your position.

insufficient_information.heading: Your answers do not settle this yet
insufficient_information.result_copy: At least one detail needed to reach a conclusion is still unconfirmed, so this check cannot tell you where you stand without guessing — and on a tax position a guess is worse than no answer. A short personalised review works through the missing detail and sets out where you actually stand.

_ruled.rule: explainer/happy-path 67; money/structural 147; the drafter's criticality and severity kept as drafted

per_state.automatic-uk-183-days: STRUCTURAL: an automatic UK-resident determination — worldwide income becomes taxable. Adverse outcome, not an explainer.
per_state.automatic-uk-only-home: STRUCTURAL: the only-home test MET makes you UK resident automatically. Same adverse determination as the 183-day test.
per_state.automatic-uk-full-time-work: STRUCTURAL + money:75% — UK resident by full-time work, and the drafter already had this at 147.
per_state.sufficient-ties-previously-resident: STRUCTURAL: this is the product's own calculation — the day bands against the tie count, Table A and Table B. The engine turns on it.
per_state.automatic-overseas-previously-resident: HAPPY PATH: an automatic overseas test met — you are non-resident. A clear, favourable determination.
per_state.automatic-overseas-not-previously-reside: HAPPY PATH: same shape, the not-previously-resident limb.
per_state.automatic-overseas-full-time-work-abroad: HAPPY PATH: full-time work abroad met — non-resident.
per_state.split-year-treatment-explainer: EXPLAINER by name and by content — it explains the split-year cases, it does not determine one.
per_state.temporary-non-residence-explainer: EXPLAINER by name — the temporary non-residence anti-avoidance rule, explained.
per_state.significant-break-overseas-work: EXPLAINER: what a significant break is. Feeds the overseas-work test rather than deciding it.
